entry_sequence.transcript_quote: This strategy needs to be traded at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time, New York time.
entry_sequence.action: At 9:30 AM ET, define the initial range by marking the high and low of the first 5-minute candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: This establishes the initial volatility range for the trading session.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: We are essentially waiting for the one minute time frame candles to print into one of these sides of the range.
entry_sequence.action: Wait for the 1-minute candle to close outside of the established 5-minute range (breakout).
entry_sequence.rationale: The breakout confirms the market direction (up or down) for the trade.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: What we're looking for is a fair value gap sequence that is printing outside of the range.
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a Fair Value Gap (FVG) sequence to form outside of the 5-minute range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The FVG provides a high-probability entry point after the initial directional breakout.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: My entry is going to be on the closure of that third candle.
entry_sequence.action: Enter the trade (long or short) on the closure of the third candle of the FVG sequence.
entry_sequence.rationale: Entering on the closure confirms the FVG structure and minimizes entry risk.

stop.transcript_quote: And then what I want you to do for the stop loss is we're just going to put it at the bottom of the fair value candle. Really simple. If this candle had a big wick, then you would also include the wick.
stop.rationale: The stop is placed at the bottom of the FVG candle, including the wick, to allow room for breathing.

targets.transcript_quote: And then all we're going to do for the target is we're going to have a fixed target. And the fixed target we're looking for is a risk-to-reward ratio of two.
targets.rationale: The strategy uses a fixed mechanical target based on a 2R risk-to-reward ratio.
